en: Black-and-white view of a European town square with a row of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings in eclectic and half‑timbered styles. Ground floors host shops and a restaurant; upper floors are residential. A small wooden kiosk or guard hut stands in the open square, along with a tall ornate streetlamp. A few people, including women and children, stand near one of the storefronts. Visible German-language shop signs are on the façades.
